record.field: AI Orders: Find customer
code

Finds the customer who is ordering, by email, phone number or company name (in that order of reliability). On the website chat the visitor must give both the email and the phone registered with us. Returns the matching customers with their id, city, delivery route and pricelist. If several customers match, ask which one before creating anything.
AI Orders: Find products
code

Finds sellable products from the words the customer used (name, internal reference or the alternative names customers use). Call it once per product mentioned. Returns candidates with id, reference, name, unit, list price and the units it can be sold in (for example boxes of several kg). If more than one candidate fits, choose only when the customer's words make it obvious; otherwise ask.

AI Orders: Customer history
code

Returns the last confirmed order of a customer with its lines (to repeat it when the customer asks for "the same as last time"), the products they usually order, and up to three products that similar customers buy and this one does not (to suggest one, briefly, at the end).
AI Orders: Create quotation
code

Creates the order as a draft quotation for the customer, to be validated by a person. product_ids, quantities and uoms are parallel lists: one position per line. Leave a uom empty to use the product unit. Returns the quotation number, a link to view it online (portal_url), the lines with prices and the totals: then write the reply to the customer yourself. On the website chat, give the link as a Markdown link such as [View quotation S00012](portal_url).

AI Orders: Update quotation
code

Changes a draft quotation of the same customer: sets the quantity of each given product (adds the line if missing, removes it with quantity 0) and, when the customer confirms the summary, marks it as confirmed by the customer. It never confirms the order itself: the team validates it. Then write the reply to the customer yourself.
